chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Playing for the military bases and sidemen drafted
summary: He played every base and USO and lost Bob Range to the army.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And, I played practically every base.
But, you did furnish quite a service for the Armed Forces?

Right. You're talking about the USO out there in California. up here The Pier in New York. All the big ones, I played them all. I didn't miss not one of those places. It was like being in the Service. You know, I'd play my date and then do one for the Service.
Were any of the side-men in your band drafted?
Oh, yeah. I can't remember all of them, but quite a few. Bob Range was in. He was across the sea. I had, let's see. Who else went in? Well, a few others.
Cause when I added Ridley and all them on sax, well, they was taking other peoples places.
